description: Documentation updates to remove vekd/SQLite references and add Turso/Docker+Fly deployment model across all docs and README
steps: Update docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md: Phase 2 deps from SQLite to Turso C SDK, section 2.4 db is Turso/libsql, section 2.5 jobs persist to Turso, Phase 4 marked REMOVED and replaced with Docker+Fly deployment
Update docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: Remove vekd from overview, replace Deployment Architecture with Docker/container model, update env vars to TURSO_DATABASE_URL
Update docs/BYTECODE_SPEC.md: Remove vekd reference from verification description
Update docs/LANGUAGE_SPEC.md: Change :sqlite symbol example to env :production
Rewrite README.md with full getting-started, env vars (TURSO_DATABASE_URL, TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN), deployment, stdlib reference
acceptance_criteria: No references to vekd as an active component (historical REMOVED note is acceptable)
No references to SQLite as a database backend
No references to Fly Volumes or local-disk DB
README has getting-started, deployment, and stdlib sections
Phase 4 in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md is marked REMOVED with Docker+Fly replacement
verification: grep -rn 'SQLite\|sqlite\|:8080 dashboard\|Fly Volumes' docs/ README.md returns no matches (except in REMOVED context)
grep -rn 'TURSO_URL' docs/ README.md shows only TURSO_DATABASE_URL (not bare TURSO_URL)
findings: Previous commit 628a30c already did the bulk of the doc rewrite (removing vekd, adding Turso/Docker+Fly). This commit fixes the env var naming (TURSO_URL -> TURSO_DATABASE_URL to match Turso SDK convention) and updates the LANGUAGE_SPEC symbol example from 'db :turso' to 'env :production'. Note: the source code still uses SQLite internally (sqlite3.c is compiled); the code-level Turso migration is a separate feature.
